=== P2: the golden consumer-only e2e can silently skip ===
FILE: pipeline/test/integration/fixture-deterministic.test.ts.
Line 137-141: `const hasSeed = existsSync(SEED_PATH); const dscribe = hasSeed ? describe : describe.skip;` gates the ENTIRE rewritten golden block on cache-seed.json's presence. But that block (the one that calls runPipeline with stepRunners, ~line 263-270) is now SEED-INDEPENDENT: it only reads FIXTURE_DIR/articles.json + roster.json and injects the four consumer steps via stepRunners; it never reads SEED_PATH. So if cache-seed.json is ever absent (it may be deleted in C5/C6), the whole golden proof turns into describe.skip with no loud failure -- a hollow test.
FIX: run the rewritten consumer-only golden block UNCONDITIONALLY (plain `describe`, no hasSeed gate). Keep the hasSeed/describe.skip gate ONLY on the sub-block that genuinely needs the seed (the 'failure modes' tests at ~line 428+ that read/write cache-seed.json, and the separate golden 'abstain_by_step' block keyed on the gitignored run dir, which stays gated on its own hasGolden as-is). After this, the four-consumer-step golden e2e must ALWAYS run (and pass) regardless of cache-seed.json.

=== P3: quote prefix-truncation can split a surrogate pair ===
FILE: pipeline/src/agents/pipeline/retrieve-report-contract.ts, truncateQuotePreservingBytes (~line 620): `trimmed.slice(0, limit).trimEnd()`. If a genuinely verbatim quote exceeds the cap (maxQuoteChars, 320) and the boundary lands mid astral character (emoji etc.), slice() splits the surrogate pair, leaving a lone high surrogate so the result is no longer a substring of the raw chunk text -- breaking the byte-for-byte guarantee this helper exists to uphold.
FIX: make the prefix cut surrogate-safe: if the char at the cut boundary would leave a trailing lone high surrogate (code unit in 0xD800..0xDBFF at the end), back the cut off by one code unit so the prefix ends on a whole code point. Keep it a contiguous prefix (still a substring). Add/extend a test proving a >cap verbatim quote ending mid-surrogate stays a valid substring of the source after truncation.

=== P3: the themes_total golden assertion tests an injected value, not real behavior ===
FILE: pipeline/test/integration/fixture-deterministic.test.ts (~line 192, 324-327). The fake retrieve stepRunner injects `quality_verdict: { summary: { theme_count: 1 } }` and the test asserts retrieval_quality.themes_total === 1 -- but real post-cutover retrieve.ts no longer populates quality_verdict/themes_total, so this asserts the compose seam projects an injected value, not real flow behavior.
FIX: remove the misleading themes_total assertion (and the hand-injected quality_verdict from the fake retrieve output if it exists only to feed that assertion). Replace it with an assertion on a field the post-cutover retrieve flow ACTUALLY produces in RetrievalQuality (coverage and/or independence, which the cutover derives from the retrieve step's traced feed_retrieve calls) OR drop it entirely if the stepRunner can't faithfully produce one -- do not leave an assertion that reads as real coverage but tests injected data. State which you chose.

CONSTRAINTS: touch only fixture-deterministic.test.ts and retrieve-report-contract.ts (+ its test). No production behavior change beyond the surrogate-safe cut. No scope creep.
